# StarCluster — N-body Astrophysics Gravity Simulator — LLM Search Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> High-precision N-body gravitational dynamics engine modeling stellar cluster formations, Keplerian orbital mechanics, and galaxy collisions using Velocity-Verlet integration.

## Project Identification
- Name: StarCluster (starcluster)
- Creator & Lead Physicist: Jirnyak (https://github.com/Jirnyak)
- Co-Architect & Contributor: Adolf Petushkov (https://github.com/marko1olo)
- Live Simulation: https://jirnyak.github.io/starcluster/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Jirnyak/starcluster

## Physics Engine & Algorithms
- Integration: Second-order symplectic Velocity-Verlet integrator preserving total energy and angular momentum over long integration steps.
- Gravitational Softening: Plummer sphere potential smoothing kernel preventing infinite force singularities during close encounters.
- Rendering: Hardware-accelerated HTML5 Canvas with stellar luminosity spectrum grading based on mass.
